detail.longDescription: 🔴 HyperShift CVE-2026-101919 — CVSS 8.8 Tenant Breakout Authenticated tenant embeds exec plugin in kubeconfig → HyperShift operator copies it verbatim to privileged control plane namespace → control plane RCE. Affects OpenShift Multicluster Engine. No public PoC. Patch available. Fix: patch operator + block exec plugins via admission webhook. → https:// threataft.com/articles/hypersh ift-tenant-isolation-bypass-cve-2026-101919 # CVE # Kubernetes # OpenShift # HyperShift # infosec
